candidates.tagline: World Cup ref forgets the one thing refs are known for
candidates.story: Referee Ivan Barton walked out to officiate the France vs Spain World Cup semi-final on July 15, 2026 without his vanishing spray, forcing the fourth official to sprint onto the pitch mid-free-kick to hand it to him.
candidates.why_funny: The vanishing spray is the most referee-specific gadget at the tournament — and the referee forgot it at the biggest match of the year.
candidates.alt: A soccer referee crouching on the pitch to spray a white foam vanishing-spray line before a free kick, with players and a packed stadium visible behind him

candidates.tagline: OpenAI's ChatGPT app now makes chatting the hardest thing to do
candidates.story: OpenAI relaunched its ChatGPT desktop app as a 'super app' in July 2026, defaulting to a 'ChatGPT Work' screen that buries the chat interface in a sidebar submenu — while the app ballooned from 159 MB to 1.5 GB and the minimize button closes the window entirely.
candidates.why_funny: The world's most famous chatbot shipped a redesign where its own name is the product and chatting is buried three clicks deep.
candidates.alt: Screenshot of the new ChatGPT desktop super app landing on the 'ChatGPT Work' home screen with chat hidden in a sidebar submenu, rather than showing a chat interface
